name: dsh-rembric-plugin
description: Persistent shared memory for your DeepSeek Harness agent, backed by a Rembric server. Discovers the full Rembric tool set, registers it under underscored names, and teaches the agent when to recall and what to save.

meta.title: Rembric Memory
meta.description: Long-term memory for the agent via a Rembric server: every Rembric tool is registered (memory_save, memory_search, memory_context, …), the server's usage crib-sheet is added to the system prompt, and the project is chosen from the working directory (.rembric file, env, or git binding). Token comes from the rembric/token credential or REMBRIC_API_TOKEN.
